constraints: Keep project/build.properties sbt.version, the installed sbt launcher, and CI sbt setup on one supported sbt major.
Migrate build definitions away from 0.13-only syntax before raising sbt.version; see the migration guide.

steps.instructions: Change project/build.properties sbt.version from 0.13.x to a supported release (see the replacement).
steps.title: Raise the sbt version

steps.instructions: Apply the sbt 0.13 → 1.x migration guide for operators, Build.scala layouts, and plugins, then re-resolve plugins.
steps.title: Migrate the build definition

verification.purpose: Confirm the active sbt version is the intended release.
Compile the project on the new sbt.
Run the sbt test suite on the new sbt.

rules.summary: The sbt download page lists the 0.13.x series as end of life on 2018-11-30 after five years. The final release in that line is 0.13.18.
rules.title: sbt 0.13 reached end of life
